Policy H4 Householder extensions
Extensions to dwellings will be supported where they are subordinate to the host dwelling
in scale and height and use materials that match or complement it.
Rear extensions on terraced dwellings should not project more than 4.0 m beyond the original
rear wall, unless the applicant demonstrates that neighbouring habitable rooms keep
acceptable daylight and outlook.
First-floor side windows facing a neighbour within 10 m must be obscure-glazed and non-opening
below 1.7 m.

Policy T2 Parking and access
Development that removes an off-street parking space will be supported only where the
remaining provision meets Table T2.1 or the site lies within the Town Centre Zone.
New or widened vehicle crossovers must provide visibility splays of 2.4 m by 43 m.
The splay requirement may be waived where the highway authority confirms in writing that
the road is a 20 mph street with no through traffic.

Table T2.1 Minimum off-street parking
1-2 bedrooms: 1 space
3 bedrooms: 2 spaces
4 or more bedrooms: 2 spaces plus 1 cycle store
Tandem spaces count as one space.

Policy ENV3 Trees
Development within the root protection area of a protected tree requires an arboricultural
method statement approved before work starts.
Where a tree survey is absent, the authority cannot conclude that harm is avoided.
